```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(htmltools)
# Project root: this file lives in reports/, one level below the project root
root <- if (file.exists("../_quarto.yml")) normalizePath("..") else here::here()
proj <- function(...) file.path(root, ...)
source(proj("R", "dashboard_helpers.R"))

gid <- as.character(params$geo_uid)

framework <- read_csv(proj("data", "indicator_framework.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
scorecard <- read_csv(proj("data", "scorecard_latest.csv"),
                      col_types = cols(geo_uid = "c", .default = col_guess()))
long      <- read_csv(proj("data", "indicators_long.csv"),
                      col_types = cols(geo_uid = "c", .default = col_guess()))
targets   <- read_csv(proj("data", "housing_targets.csv"),
                      col_types = cols(geo_uid = "c", .default = col_guess()))

sc   <- scorecard |> filter(geo_uid == gid)
bc   <- scorecard |> filter(geo_uid == "59")
tg   <- targets   |> filter(geo_uid == gid)
name <- sc$geo_name[1]
grp  <- sc$hto_group[1]
stopifnot(nrow(sc) > 0, nrow(tg) == 1)

headline_ids <- c("HTO_Y1", "COMPL_RATE", "CHN_ALL", "CHN_RENT", "UNAFF_RENT", "VAC")
```

```{r}
#| label: header
all_munis <- scorecard |> filter(geo_level == "Municipality") |> distinct(geo_name, hto_group) |> arrange(geo_name)
jump_options <- lapply(all_munis$geo_name, function(m)
  tags$option(value = paste0(slugify(m), ".html"), selected = if (m == name) NA else NULL, m))

tagList(
tags$nav(class = "rc-nav",
  a(class = "rc-nav-brand", href = "../index.html", "BC Municipal Housing Indicators"),
  div(class = "rc-nav-links",
    a(href = "../index.html#overview", "Overview"),
    a(href = "../index.html#scorecard", "Scorecard"),
    a(href = "../index.html#map", "Map"),
    a(href = "../index.html#indicator-framework", "Indicator framework"),
    a(href = "../index.html#about", "About"),
    a(href = "https://github.com/emmabranch/bc-housing-indicators", "GitHub")),
  tags$label(class = "rc-jump", "Report card:",
    tags$select(onchange = "window.location.href = this.value;", `aria-label` = "Jump to another municipality",
                jump_options))
),
div(class = "rc-header",
  div(class = "rc-kicker", sprintf("Housing Target Order Group %s  ·  Census subdivision %s", grp, gid)),
  h1(class = "rc-title", name),
  div(class = "rc-sub", sprintf("Municipal housing report card · data as compiled November 2026 · generated %s",
                                format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y"))),
  div(class = "rc-disclaimer",
      strong("Independent portfolio project. "),
      "Built from public data by Emma Branch. Not affiliated with, produced for, or endorsed by BC Housing or the Government of British Columbia. Status thresholds are illustrative.")
))
```

## Headline indicators

```{r}
#| label: summary-table
comparator_label <- function(id, r) {
  if (id == "HTO_Y1") return("Target 100%")
  if (id == "VAC") return("Reference 3%")
  b <- bc |> filter(indicator_id == id)
  if (is.na(r$comparator_value)) return("–")
  sprintf("BC %s", fmt_value(id, r$comparator_value))
}
change_label <- function(id, r) {
  if (is.na(r$prior_value) || id %in% c("HTO_Y1", "COMPL_RATE")) return("–")
  d <- r$latest_value - r$prior_value
  unit <- if (id %in% c("CHN_ALL", "CHN_RENT", "UNAFF_RENT", "VAC")) " pts" else ""
  sprintf("%s%s%s since %s", if (d > 0) "+" else "", formatC(d, format = "f", digits = 1), unit, r$prior_year)
}

rows <- lapply(headline_ids, function(id) {
  r  <- sc |> filter(indicator_id == id)
  fw <- framework |> filter(indicator_id == id)
  tags$tr(
    tags$td(class = "rc-ind", fw$indicator_name, div(class = "rc-unit", fw$unit)),
    tags$td(class = "rc-c", status_chip(r$status, fmt_value(id, r$latest_value),
                                        out_of_date = isTRUE(r$out_of_date))),
    tags$td(class = "rc-c", ifelse(is.na(r$latest_year), "–", r$latest_year)),
    tags$td(class = "rc-c", comparator_label(id, r)),
    tags$td(class = "rc-c", change_label(id, r)),
    tags$td(class = "rc-c rc-status", r$status)
  )
})

tags$table(class = "rc-table",
  tags$thead(tags$tr(
    tags$th("Indicator"), tags$th("Value"), tags$th("Year"),
    tags$th("Comparator"), tags$th("Change"), tags$th("Status"))),
  tags$tbody(rows))
```

```{r}
#| label: legend
p(class = "rc-note",
  "✓ Green: meets target or benchmark. ! Amber: near it. ✕ Red: below it. ",
  "Need and affordability indicators: lower is better, compared with the BC rate (Amber = up to 2 points above). ",
  "Completions: compared with the BC rate (Amber = 75% to 99.9% of it). ",
  "† = latest value older than the most recent survey year.")
```

## Housing Supply Act target

```{r}
#| label: target
fmt_n <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "–", format(x, big.mark = ","))
hto_status <- sc |> filter(indicator_id == "HTO_Y1")
target_text <- if (is.na(tg$y1_net_new)) {
  sprintf("Year 1 runs %s to %s. Results had not been published when this report card was compiled.",
          tg$y1_period_start, tg$y1_period_end)
} else {
  sprintf("In Year 1 (%s to %s), %s reported %s net new units against a Year 1 target of %s: %s of target.",
          tg$y1_period_start, tg$y1_period_end, name, fmt_n(tg$y1_net_new),
          fmt_n(tg$target_y1), fmt_value("HTO_Y1", tg$y1_pct_of_target))
}
src_text <- if (is.na(tg$y1_src_type)) "" else sprintf(
  "Year 1 source: %s%s.", tg$y1_src_type,
  if (isTRUE(tg$y1_verified_primary)) ", verified against a primary source" else ", not independently verified")

div(class = "rc-target",
  div(class = "rc-target-figs",
    div(class = "rc-fig", div(class = "rc-fig-n", fmt_n(tg$target_5yr)), div(class = "rc-fig-l", "Five-year target (net new units)")),
    div(class = "rc-fig", div(class = "rc-fig-n", fmt_n(tg$target_y1)), div(class = "rc-fig-l", "Year 1 target")),
    div(class = "rc-fig", div(class = "rc-fig-n", fmt_n(tg$y1_net_new)), div(class = "rc-fig-l", "Year 1 net new units")),
    div(class = "rc-fig", status_chip(hto_status$status, fmt_value("HTO_Y1", tg$y1_pct_of_target)),
        div(class = "rc-fig-l", "Year 1 % of target"))
  ),
  p(target_text),
  p(class = "rc-note", "Net new units = completions (occupancy permits) minus demolitions. ", src_text)
)
```

## Trends

```{r}
#| label: trends
series <- function(id, from = 2005) long |> filter(geo_uid == gid, indicator_id == id, year >= from, !is.na(value))
pct  <- function(v) paste0(formatC(v, format = "f", digits = 1), "%")
vac  <- series("VAC"); compl <- series("COMPL"); rent <- series("RENT_AVG")

chart_or_note <- function(d, title, ...) {
  div(class = "rc-chart",
      div(class = "rc-chart-title", title),
      if (nrow(d) >= 2) svg_linechart(d$year, d$value, width = 340, height = 170, ...)
      else p(class = "rc-note", "No CMHC data published for this municipality."))
}

div(class = "rc-charts",
  chart_or_note(vac, "Rental vacancy rate (%), October", ref = 3, ref_label = "3% reference", value_fmt = pct),
  chart_or_note(rent, "Average rent ($/month), October", value_fmt = function(v) paste0("$", format(round(v), big.mark = ","))),
  chart_or_note(compl, "Housing completions (units per year)", value_fmt = function(v) format(round(v), big.mark = ","))
)
```

## Data notes

```{r}
#| label: notes
notes <- c()
ood <- sc |> filter(out_of_date, kpi_type == "Headline KPI (RAG)" | indicator_id == "RENT_CHG")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ood))) {
  fw <- framework |> filter(indicator_id == ood$indicator_id[i])
  notes <- c(notes, sprintf("%s: latest published value is from %s; later years were suppressed by CMHC.",
                            fw$indicator_name, ood$latest_year[i]))
}
nodata <- sc |> filter(status == "No data")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(nodata))) {
  fw <- framework |> filter(indicator_id == nodata$indicator_id[i])
  notes <- c(notes, sprintf("%s: no data published for %s.", fw$indicator_name, name))
}
fair <- sc |> filter(str_detect(coalesce(latest_quality, ""), "Fair"))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(fair))) {
  fw <- framework |> filter(indicator_id == fair$indicator_id[i])
  notes <- c(notes, sprintf("%s: CMHC rates the latest value \"Fair (Use with Caution)\".", fw$indicator_name))
}
notes <- c(notes,
  "Census indicators are from 2021, the latest available; 2020 incomes included temporary pandemic benefits, which likely lowered measured need.",
  "Values are for the municipality (census subdivision), not the wider metropolitan area, so they will differ from published CMA figures.")

tags$ul(class = "rc-notes", lapply(notes, tags$li))
```
